periods.time: Late phase of Ikki versus Moroboshi
periods.location: Osaka Bay Dome stands and outer corridor
periods.summary: Koume flees the stands because she cannot bear seeing Yuudai fight and bleed for her sake. Shizuku follows, tells her that younger sisters are allowed to rely on their elder brothers, and Koume returns to shout encouragement to Yuudai for the first time in years.
periods.cause: Yuudai's worsening condition makes Koume's guilt from the train accident unbearable.
periods.process: Shizuku compares Koume's pain to her own love for Ikki, then reframes relying on an elder brother as a sibling's right rather than a burden. Hearing that the match is ending, Koume chooses what she actually wants to do: cheer for Yuudai.
periods.outcome: Koume's voice reaches Yuudai, who answers that he will handle it and launches his final counterattack. Her words mark the beginning of healing from the guilt that silenced her.
periods.significance: Resolves the emotional core of Moroboshi's backstory and triggers his final heroic effort.
